facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the planet's exploitation rights were ceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems by Onaconda Farr, the Galactic Republic senator of Rodia.

facts.text: It was connected to the planets Tatooine, Geonosis, and Llanic via the Triellus Trade Route and was the homeworld of the hairy white bantha and the hostile reptilian horax.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Galactic Republic Senator Onaconda Farr from Rodia of the Savareen sector brokered a deal with the Confederacy of Independent Systems in which Farr would cede exploitation rights to other planets in the sector, such as Nelvaan, Christophsis, and Zaadja, in exchange for food.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Galactic Republic Senator Onaconda Farr from Rodia of the Savareen sector brokered a deal with the Confederacy of Independent Systems in which Farr would cede exploitation rights to other planets in the sector, such as Nelvaan, Christophsis, and Zaadja, in exchange for food.

facts.text: This allowed the Techno Union, a guild aligned with the Confederacy, to experiment on the peaceful Nelvaanian natives, turning them into mindless cyborg monstrosities.
